name: A Suit of Armor Around the Galaxy (Updated 11 Nov 23)
description_md: Deck update code: [541240](https://marvelcdb.com/deck/view/541240) (update notes at the bottom) ![Star-Lord <3 Iron Man](https://i.imgur.com/vwXVgze.png) [Star-Lord](/card/17001a) leadership without [Blaze of Glory](/card/17015)?!?!? A dr00 Leadership deck with*out* [Strength In Numbers](/card/03017)?? What *is* this madness? This is [Iron](/card/09039) [Guardian](/card/22033) (of the Galaxy) The deck concept is very simple: play [Guardians of the Galaxy](/card/22033), find [Iron Man](/card/09039) as quickly as possible, then load him up with everything. Due to his upgrade discount and Guardians of the Galaxy's subsidization plan, every upgrade is FREE* on Iron Man. *by free we mean resource neutral since they will cost 0 and the card you draw will replace the one you spent. ![Iron Guardian](https://i.imgur.com/fFqrFfw.png) *This isn't even my final form!* [Star-Lord](/card/17001b)'s hero ability and [Honorary Guardian](/card/22035), coupled with [Iron Man](/card/09039)'s own _**Avengers**_ trait open up a multitude of available attachments. - [Comms Implant](/card/18030) +1 THW / +1 HP - [Honorary Guardian](/card/22035) +1 HP (and keeps Iron Man a guardian) - [Inspired](/card/01074) +1 THW / +1 ATK - [Laser Blaster](/card/17019) +1 ATK (and attacks gain overkill) - [Leader of the Guardians](/card/17009) not an attachment for Iron Man, but gives him +1 THW while you're in hero form or while Iron Man has [Honorary Guardian](/card/22035) - [Power Gloves](/card/12017) Deals 1 damage after attacking or thwarting - [Reinforced Suit](/card/12018) +2 HP - [Sky Cycle](/card/04015) allows Iron Man to activate twice per turn And by the time Iron Man finishes building his suit, he'll be a 5 THW, 4 ATK ally with 7 HP that deals 1 every time he activates and can activate twice per round. One copy of [First Aid](/card/01086) is included to help keep him healthy, but you can include more copies if you wish and/or include [Innovation](/card/21058) (which, incidentally I was using until I sat down for the write-up! Thanks for the reminder, George Kaplan). Allies - For the remaining allies, I have chosen as many with card draw abilities as possible ([Ironheart](/card/13018), [Maria Hill](/card/01067), and [Nick Fury](/card/01084)) while also avoiding any Avengers (sorry [White Tiger](/card/21013)!) so that [Call for Aid](/card/12015) will always find [Iron Man](/card/09039). [Blockingbird](/card/01083) is great as always, but there are some wonderful alternatives, such as [Adam Warlock](/card/17011), [Beta Ray Bill](/card/17012), [Major Victory](/card/21053), [Spider-Man](/card/13019), or any of the neutral guardians allies: [Drax](/card/18019), [Gamora](/card/19020), [Groot](/card/16047), [Martinex](/card/21065), or [Rocket Raccoon](/card/16019). [Call for Aid](/card/12015) has multiple uses despite having only one _**Avenger**_. In actuality, it for that reason Call for Aid has other lines of play. Keep in mind that once you have played Iron Man, calling again will deck yourself immediately and deal you an encounter card. For many heroes, there is not much value from that (paying a card and receiving an encounter card just to reshuffle). *However*, [Star-Lord](/card/17001b) benefits from having extra encounter cards in front of him, whether you are building for a large [Sliding Shot](/card/17005) or simply trying to get the most out of [Star-Lord's Helmet](/card/17010) or [Jet Boots](/card/17008). That said, you may find that 2 copies is enough, but I would definitely not recommend going to 1; you want to find Iron Man and start building as quickly as possible. [Band Together](/card/21018) pulls its weight as it's quite easy to have 2-3 allies at a time, and you'll always have at least 1 giant Iron Man ally. Late game, it can help pay for [Sliding Shot](/card/17005) or [Gutsy Move](/card/17004) for some fun combo turns. If you draw it at the beginning of the game, remember that you can stash it away for later with _Smooth Talker_ (thanks @journeyman2 for the tip!). [Guardians of the Galaxy](/card/22033) only allows you to have one in play, but it's so crucial to the deck that 2 copies are included. You could go to 3 or drop down to 1. Keep in mind that you can play them for other players (even if they don't have any Guardians characters) just if you want to get it out of your deck once you have your own. Just remember that it only works while all of your characters are Guardians, so while you are in hero form, it's always on for Star-Lord, but when you go to alter-ego, it only works if he and every ally you have is a Guardian already or has [Honorary Guardian](/card/22035). Just something to keep in mind while playing and for changing up the deck. And finally, [Knowhere](/card/17022) helps give you some more ally options and will also help subsidize those costs as well, but it's not as much of a priority as it is for other decks. Looking to the future: Sidearm (War Machine spoiler) sounds like a great fit, so definitely keep that one in mind. And really, keep an eye out for any 0-1 cost basic or leadership ally attachment. Any non-avengers allies will be helpful, especially if they can draw cards; and with the upcoming new box, hopefully we'll have plenty of new non-avengers to choose from. **Update Nov '23** Deck update code: [541240](https://marvelcdb.com/deck/view/541240) The main differences with the update are a leaner Ally line, just [Gamora](/card/19020), [White Fox](/card/40057), and of course, [Iron Man](/card/09039). [Band Together](/card/21018) has been replaced with [Digging Deep](/card/40060), which gets a lot more value you here. You get up to 3 extra resources every time you Call For Aid. With fewer allies, [Band Together](/card/21018) doesn't get as much value, but that's fine. Digging Deep lets you constantly generate resources, and you don't need to spend it on something expensive. Although we are replacing a potentially 3-resource card for three single-resource cards, the value is definitely worth it. [Call for Aid](/card/12015) turns into a Band Together + an extra encounter card anyway. Have removed [First Aid](/card/01086) and [Innovation](/card/21058) for [Build Support](/card/40027) to play [IPAC](/card/41022). If another player at the table is using Build Support, you can still run yours for Guardians of the Galaxy or even Bad Boy. Alternatively, you can take out 1 copy of [Guardians of the Galaxy](/card/22033) and [IPAC](/card/41022) for [First Aid](/card/01086) and [Innovation](/card/21058). I think First Aid and Innovation are not super necessary. I've definitely let Iron Man die before and played him almost fully the very next round before. Once you're set up, things start cruising. It's really not difficult to build back up. Also cut 1 copy of [Call for Aid](/card/12015) for [Superpower Training](/card/40059), which can find so many great things, like [Leader of the Guardians](/card/17009), [Element Gun](/card/17007), or [Star-Lord's Helmet](/card/17010), and [Jet Boots](/card/17008) are nice too if you've played everything else. ![Iron Guardian](https://i.imgur.com/5setG5W.png) Until next time, see you, space-guardian.
